name: Don Alfonso 1890
address: Corso Sant'Agata 11, 80061, Sant'Agata sui Due Golfi
dinnerNote: Typical spend without drinks (Gambero Rosso average)
dinnerNoteIt: Spesa media bevande escluse (media Gambero Rosso)
hotel: the family's own Boutique Hotel Don Alfonso 1890
bookingOpens: Online through CoverManager on the restaurant's website, or by phone or email (info@donalfonso.com). The restaurant is seasonal, open from early April to the end of October: dinner Wednesday to Sunday, from 7.30pm (8pm on Saturdays and Sundays) with the last booking at 10.30pm, and lunch Friday to Sunday, 12.30pm to 2.30pm. A card is needed to hold the booking.
children: Children over 6 are welcome. Pets are not allowed.
